candidate_generator.design: packed store shortlists, exact ternary search confirms

shortlist_fidelity.note: exact top-1 inside the packed top-N; 12 questions, so a small sample

candidate_generator.verdict: answers preserved, but NOT a speed win at this corpus size: the shortlist pass dequantizes and scores all 180 packed rows in f32, so it is O(n) with f32 math and measured 1.9x slower than the exact ternary search. It becomes a win only with a packed-domain distance that avoids f32 dequantization (code-table/SIMD), or at corpus sizes where the packed store's smaller traffic dominates. Kept opt-in (`gen=N`), default path unchanged.
